messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert — multiple container restarts on runtime-prod-gpupool-12. Observed symptom: GPU OOM during prefill for long-context requests (>= 64k tokens). Auto-pager sent to oncall.

sara (oncall): ack, paging in. I’m on it — collecting logs + recent deploys. Starting runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/prefill-oom

matt (eng-runtime): seeing repeated kernel errors followed by container restart. Example from /var/log/containers/runtime-abc.log:
```
2026-03-15T02:02:11Z ERROR runtime: cudaAssertFail: out of memory at alloc.cu:214
prefill: requested 75000 tokens, available kv cache bytes 1.2GB
stack: serve_prefill -> kv_alloc -> cudaMalloc -> segfault
```

julia (eng-sre): wow large prefill. Are these user requests or batch jobs? Any specific model/version spiking?

matt (eng-runtime): spikes are from model: redwood-13b-v1 (fp16, q8_0) pinned on that pool. A few heavy users sending very long chat history via client-side replay. Traffic started increasing ~02:00 UTC.

sara (oncall): initial impact: 8% of requests to /v1/chat stream errors (container crash) in the last 10m; tail latency for successful requests up x3. Paging cust-impact. @ryan can you surface affected customers?

ryan (support): Customer "EdgeDocs" reported failing embeddings & chat completions starting ~01:58. They sent logs complaining about sudden disconnects. I'll reach out and confirm scope & escalate if needed.

julia (eng-sre): mitigation plan (short term): 1) Disable prefill-parallelism / reduce max_prefill_tokens per pod to 16k via env PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=16000 2) Enable fallback routing of >16k requests to a CPU-backed instance or smaller context-capable model 3) Evict large cached prefixes (force kv cache eviction) 4) Add a temporary admission control in gateway to reject >32k tokens with 429

matt (eng-runtime): prepared hotpatch: updating deployment runtime-prod-gpupool-12 with env change and kernel guard. Command I will run:
```bash
kubectl set env deploy/runtime-prod-gpupool-12 PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=16000 --namespace=prod
kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime-prod-gpupool-12 --namespace=prod
```

sara (oncall): go for it. I'll monitor metrics (OOM counts, restarts, error-rate). @ops-bot please hold autoscaler until we stabilize so we don't spin up more risky pods.

ops-bot: autoscaler paused for runtime-prod-gpupool-12 by sara at 02:10 UTC.

matt (eng-runtime): hotpatch applied. rollout started. Watching pod restarts...

sara (oncall): after patch: OOMs dropped to 0 in last 3m, restarts falling. Error-rate down to 1.5%. Still seeing some failures for in-flight very long requests (they get killed mid-prefill).

julia (eng-sre): medium-term: add request-size based routing in model-router + soft-degradation path that returns a concise fallback (truncated context with warning) instead of killing process. Also need to educate SDK to split very long histories on client side.

ryan (support): update from EdgeDocs: they saw ~25 failed calls, now successful after ~02:15. They want a root cause note for their SREs. I created support ticket 2026-9876 and marked as incident-linked.

sara (oncall): severity decision: keep SEV2. Assign eng-runtime (matt) for RCA and eng-sre (julia) for mitigations & infra changes. I'll hand off to julia for night coverage in 30m.

matt (eng-runtime): collecting heap dumps + nvml traces; will open a postmortem draft and include stack traces + reproducer script. Suspect kv-cache accounting bug + insufficient prefill-safeguard for long contexts.

julia (eng-sre): I'll schedule a follow-up change: admission control + 429 for >32k and a graceful fallback doc. Also provisioning a dedicated pool with larger GPU memory for verified large-context customers.

sara (oncall): handing off to julia. Key action list in channel: 1) RCA ticket & postmortem 2) hotpatch rollback criteria 3) svc-level admission control 4) customer comms (ryan) 5) monitor for 2h then downgrade incident if stable.

julia (eng-sre): ack — taking over. Setting paging window to 02:40 UTC for followups. If anyone sees reoccurrence ping me directly. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-15-3333334444 created, SEV2. Linked: support/2026-9876, rca/2026-3333.

sara (oncall): note for postmortem: add timeline, sample offending request (sanitized), and recommend SDK changes + server-side caps.
